# Code of Conduct

Drop should be a respectful, welcoming, and technically constructive project.
This applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and other official
project spaces.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and considerate.
- Critique ideas and code, not people.
- Give actionable feedback and assume good intent.
- Welcome questions and different experience levels.
- Respect privacy and protect information shared in confidence.
- Report security issues through the private process in
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, threats, or personal attacks.
- Sexualized language or unwelcome attention.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Deliberate disruption, trolling, or bad-faith participation.
- Unsafe testing against users, public deployments, or production data.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to
[hello@ponchii.com](mailto:hello@ponchii.com). Reports will be handled as
confidentially as practical. Maintainers may edit or remove contributions,
comments, or issues and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation
when necessary.
